title: Dental Practice Management Software
intro: DentiChair is dental practice management software that runs patients, appointments, clinical charting, billing and laboratory cases in one application.

title: Dental Clinic Management System
intro: DentiChair is a dental clinic management system that organizes patients, appointments, clinical records, billing and labs in one fast desktop application.

title: Dental Software
intro: DentiChair is dental software built for clinics: one desktop application for the front desk, the treatment room and the finance office.

title: Dental Patient Records Software
intro: DentiChair keeps complete digital patient records for dental clinics, including medical history, notes, odontograms, periodontal charts and X-rays.

title: Dental Appointment Scheduling Software
intro: DentiChair helps dental clinics schedule appointments, reduce no-shows with automatic reminders and take appointment requests in one place.

title: Dental Billing Software
intro: DentiChair handles dental billing for clinics with invoices, insurance claims, payment plans and clear financial visibility.
